Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard returns.
For a standard return, items must be returned within 30 days, unused, uninstalled, and in their original packaging. Standard returns are subject to a 20% restocking fee, non-refundable payment processing fees, and the customer covers return shipping costs.
In contrast, if your item arrives damaged and you report it within 5 business days of delivery with photos of the damaged item and packaging, we will make it right at no cost to you—there are no restocking or processing fees, and we cover the shipping for the replacement.
